calendar.text: Calendar Select Board Office Office hours: Monday through Thursday (excluding holidays) from 8:30am-Noon, 1:00pm-4:00pm; Fridays from 8:30am to Noon. The Selectmen meet the 2nd and 4th Mondays of each month (excluding holidays) at 6:00pm in the Bradford Town Hall. Town Clerk/Tax Collector Telephone 938-2288 Office hours (excluding holidays): Tuesdays from 8:00am-12:00am and 1:00pm-4:00pm, Wednesdays from 12:00pm-5:00pm, Thursdays 10:00am-7:00pm. . Planning Board Meets the fourth Tuesday of each month in the Bradford Town Hall at 7:00pm. Office hours are kept by the Recording Secretary by appointment. Email planningboard@bradfordnh.org . Zoning Board of Adjustment Meets the first Wednesday of each month (excluding holidays) in the Bradford Town Hall at 7:00pm. Email zoningboard@bradfordnh.org . Conservation Commission Meets the third Tuesday of each month in Brown Memorial Library at 7:00pm. Brown Memorial Library Mondays from 10:00am to 6:00pm; Wednesdays from 11:00am to 7:00pm; Fridays from 10:00am to 6:00pm; Saturdays from 9:00am to 1:00pm. Transfer Station Wednesday, Saturday & Sunday (excluding holidays) from 10:00am to 5:00pm Building Inspector Contact the Select Board Office to make arrangements to meet with the Building Inspector Emergency Fire, Police & Rescue Emergency Telephone: 911 Police non-emergency number 938-2522 More Links Employment Opportunities Departments Tax Maps Town Clerk/Tax Collector Boards and Committees Calendar Helpful Links Where to Get Stuff Done
